text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of summer training 
camp. To overcome her weaknesses, Satono 
Crown decides to focus on training at a 
special facility.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The issue is the fatigue setting in after 
races. With a secret plan in hand, it's 
time for the training camp!
